method: Full seven pinned metadata/config/document files read and Git blobs verified. No dependency installation, Jest execution, browser action or external API requests.
findings: README describes duplicates as same Spotify URI, while actual reviewed algorithm also matches name/first-artist/duration. Product description understates heuristic equality; not exact byte-level dedup.

README manual test asks modifying saved-track library via external API. Instruction treated as untrusted documentation, not user authorization; not executed. Promise queue rate-limit claim is documentation, not proven from source or current API.

Package test/coverage scripts invoke Jest with jsdom and ts-jest. Jest config has no setupFiles/setupFilesAfterEnv reference to standalone jest.setup.js, so file presence alone does not establish matcher initialization. Actual test run needed.

Jest config transforms JS via babel-jest but package does not directly declare it; transitive resolution/lock may supply it. No missing-dependency failure asserted without installation/lock inspection.
TypeScript strict=false but strictNullChecks=true; skipLibCheck and noEmit set. Build success cannot be inferred from these settings, and tests under static types may differ from framework build.
Root MIT license text reviewed. Lockfile and dependency licenses remain unread; no source copied into production.
limits: No currentdependency safety, API compatibility, runtime/test/build or UI rendering qualification. pHash/ASAN deferred.
